title: Winged Angel in Ruins
description: A barefoot man with large, intricate blue and gold mechanical wings stands on cracked stone pavement. He is surrounded by vibrant red poppies, classical ruins, and dramatic red and blue paint dripping from above against a cloudy sky with a glowing halo.
prompt: A man with curly dark hair and large intricate blue and gold mechanical wings stands barefoot on cracked stone pavement in ancient ruins. He wears a flowing beige and dark robe. Bright red poppies grow around him. Red and blue paint drips from the top of the frame. Golden halo above his head, dramatic cloudy sky, cinematic fantasy style.
